mechanics.claim: The active shields Taric and the target ally and binds them with Bastion.
mechanics.quote: '''Taric''' grants himself and the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, binding them with ''Bastion''.

mechanics.claim: Taric can self-cast to shield only himself, and mimics his other abilities to the bound ally while the passive tether persists.
mechanics.quote: '''Taric's''' abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus armor and the ally-mimicked abilities require the tether to persist; only one ally can be bound at a time.
mechanics.quote: Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.
